s.note: Thor's first breakfast at the diner
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Season well and shape into small flat cakes. Fry in butter over medium heat for 5 minutes a side until deep golden and crisp. Serve hot with sour cream and chives.

Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 4 tbsp honey, crushed garlic and thyme leaves. Toss the hot wings through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter fit for a feast.

m.n: Asgardian feast beef ribs with roast roots
m.note: the great hall feast in Asgard
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt and cracked pepper. Roast covered at 140C for 5 hours until tender. For the last hour, add chunks of carrot, parsnip and potato to the tray to roast in the juices. Serve on a big board with crusty bread.

w.n: Puente Antiguo churros with hot chocolate
w.note: the dusty little New Mexico town where Thor lands
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 30g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 1 egg. Pipe 10cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring smooth, for dipping.

d.note: Thor smashing the mug and asking for another
d.how: Brew 600ml strong coffee, stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar and chill for at least 1 hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each of 4 tall glasses, then pour over the coffee and 50ml cold milk each. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate over dark chocolate. Serve with a straw and a long spoon, and try not to smash the glass.
